issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'גדליהו בן אחיקם' (Gedaliah son of Ahikam) speaking to 'יוחנן בן קרח' (Johanan son of Kareah). The Chinese renders '耶大亞兒子亞希甘' which reverses the father-son relationship: it makes Ahikam the son of Gedaliah instead of Gedaliah being the son of Ahikam. The correct rendering should be '亞希甘的兒子基大利' (Gedaliah son of Ahikam).
